access.notes: Open-source quantum chemistry software capable of B3LYP/6-31G(d) and MPWKCIS/6-31+G(d,p) with PCM solvation. Alternative open-source codes (NWChem, PySCF) are acceptable.

resources.name: Keggin-Al13 cluster structure

access.notes: The Keggin-Al13 epsilon-isomer structure is publicly known; atomic coordinates can be constructed from crystallographic data or chemical reasoning. The paper describes the substitution patterns for inter- and intra-trimer fluorine bridges.

resources.notes: No pre-built coordinate file is required.
